description: This file contains the implementation of URI template expansion based on RFC 6570, including functions and structures for processing URI templates with variable substitution, reserved expansion, and different expansion styles.

classes.name: UriTemplateConfig
classes.description: Structure representing configuration for URI template variable expansion, including prefix, joiner, and expansion rules.

methods.name: MakeConfig
methods.description: Creates a UriTemplateConfig object based on the variable prefix character, determining the expansion style.

methods.name: ProcessVariableSection
methods.description: Processes a comma-separated list of variables within a URI template, appending their expanded values to the target string.

methods.name: Expand
methods.description: Main function to expand a URI template string with provided parameters, producing an expanded URI or indicating failure.
